title: George Parker Heathcote
dates: (1828-15 Feb 1871)
---

son of Sir William Heathcote’s first marriage

He returned from India a cripple with ‘creeping paralysis’ in February 1860.

He married (15 Jun 1869) his cousin Isabella Margaretta Elizabeth Walpole (d. 1938).

After the Moberlys left Field House he lived there.
